- VS Code Version: 1.65.0-insiders
- OS Version: windows 10 

Steps to Reproduce:

1. Have an extension that leverages microsoft authentication
2) sign in through browser flow 
3) if you inspect the auth session that was created

stable: 
```
{
    id: "72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7.../f934b166-8c65-428e-b8c8-a9.../901a1c79-80d9-411f-b17...",
    accessToken: <token>,
    account: {
      label: "alias@microsoft.com",
      id: "72f988bf-86f1.../f934b166-8c65-428e-b8c8-a9fb...",
    },
    scopes: [
      "499b84ac-1321-427f-aa17-267ca6975798/.default",
      "offline_access",
    ],
  }
```

insiders: 
```
{
    id: "72f988bf-86f1-4..../undefined/c816eae4-e3c5-4718-a742-b....",
    accessToken: <token>,
    idToken: "eyJ0e",
    account: {
      label: "name@microsoft.com",
      id: "72f988bf-86f1-41af-.../undefined",
    },
    scopes: [
      "499b84ac-1321-427f-aa17-267ca6975798/.default",
      "email",
      "offline_access",
      "openid",
    ],
  }
```

Both the id, and account.id properties now have /undefined/ within them
